title: Employee Travel and Expense Policy
provenance: synthetic ReportLab source; fictional company Sagebridge Demo Ltd

rules.statement: Travel expenses in Germany are limited to EUR 40.00 per day.
Engineering travel expenses in France have a EUR 65.00 per transaction limit and require director approval.

exception.statement: Engineering emergency travel expenses in Germany may use a EUR 80.00 limit only with documented director approval. Without proof of the emergency and approval, escalate for human review.
